throughput_version: IR total-system throughput at reference epoch 2009-06-26; photometric calibration of October 2020 (Bajaj et al. 2020)
sensitivity_assumptions: Unresolved point source with optimal (PSF-weighted) extraction
Published values are limiting AB magnitudes at S/N = 10 in 1 hour (10-hour limits are stored for validation)
Published magnitudes are rounded to 0.1 mag (about 10% in flux)
Only filters with a published limiting magnitude are available as observing filters
